newsitem.title: CANADA: Kinross buys royalty from Inco.
newsitem.headline: Kinross buys royalty from Inco.

text.p: Kinross Gold Corp said on Thursday it has agreed to buy a two percent net smelter return royalty from Inco Ltd that covers many of the key sites at Kinross's Hoyle Pond property in Timmins, Ontario.
Kinross will give Inco one million Kinross common shares plus 200,000 warrants exercisable for one year at C$12 per share. The transaction is worth C$9.95 million, Kinross said in a statement.
Kinross said it anticipates the transaction will be non-dilutive to the company's earnings and has the potential to have a positive effect on profits.
The royalty, known as the Canico Royalty, was set up in 1978 for Inco.
